meta.title: Sebastian County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Sebastian County's 2026 budget book, as filed with the state. We use its 'Budget Summary by Fund/Department' table, which shows the 2026 budget for each office split into salaries, supplies, other services, capital, debt and transfers. Some funds send money to other county funds (the 'Interfund Transfer' column, $2,022,601 in all), so those dollars appear in both funds.
